sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (see Policy Schedule)

room_rent.note: Base policy has no room rent cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps at 1% of SI or ₹5,000/day (whichever lower) with proportionate deduction on other expenses.

icu.note: Base policy has no ICU cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps ICU at 2% of SI or ₹7,500/day (whichever lower).

copayment.note: Optional Co-Pay add-on allows insured to voluntarily opt 5%, 10% or 20% co-pay on every claim.

sub_limits.display: Cataract optional cap; domiciliary 10% of SI
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 10% of Basic SI inbuilt. Optional 'Cataract Capping' add-on (age 50+) caps cataract at ₹25k–₹40k per eye depending on SI. Modern surgeries covered under optional add-on at 50% of SI.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting is 36 months or 24 months as per plan in schedule. Optional 'PED Protector' add-on (age ≤50) reduces Diabetes & Hypertension waiting: E-Connect plan does not qualify for PED Protector (shown as NA in table).

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month wait: cataract, BPH, hernia, hydrocele, fistula, piles, sinusitis, fissure, gastric/duodenal ulcers, gout, tumors/cysts/polyps, hysterectomy, PCOD, skin tumors, ENT disorders, D&C, congenital internal diseases. 24-month: gallbladder calculus, joint replacement (degenerative), PIVD, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, spondylosis, varicose veins, laser eye correction. 36-month: obesity surgery.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt Loyalty Perk: 10% of Basic SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional 'Super Booster' add-on increases to 50%/yr up to 150% of Basic SI. Alternatively insured may choose renewal premium discount instead of bonus.

restoration.note: Restored SI = 100% of Basic SI, triggered when Basic SI + Loyalty Perk exhausted. Cannot be used for same illness/disease for which claim was paid in current year. Optional 'Reload of Sum Insured' add-on waives the same-illness restriction.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days not specified in wording; stated as 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'.

post_hosp.note: Number of days not specified in wording; stated as 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'.

day_care.note: Extensive listed procedures plus any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, etc.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to Basic SI. OPD, day care, pre/post-hospitalisation AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: Donor screening and harvesting expenses covered up to limit in Schedule. Donor pre/post-hospitalisation excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; maximum liability as specified in Schedule.

modern_treatments.note: Modern Surgeries (robotic, stereotactic, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, etc.) covered only if optional 'Modern Surgeries limit' add-on is purchased, up to 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses (Annexure-A List I items) excluded by default. Optional 'Zero Deduct cover' waives this exclusion.

global_cover.note: Emergency inpatient care outside India covered under optional 'Global Cover' add-on, up to Basic SI, reimbursement only in INR. Max 180 consecutive days abroad.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl. ectopic), STDs/HIV, dental (non-accidental), external congenital anomaly, OPD treatment, treatment outside India (unless Global Cover add-on), self-inflicted injury
optional_riders: Zero Deduct (consumables), Vector Borne Disease benefit, Super Booster (CB up to 150%), EMI Protector, PED Protector (N/A for E-Connect), Global Cover, Domestic Travel Plus, Reload of SI, Co-Pay, Modern Surgeries, Cataract Capping, Room Rent limit
